categories.main_business_segments: Guoquan Food (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a leading and rapidly growing home meal products brand in China, focusing on ready-to-eat, ready-to-heat, ready-to-cook, and prepared ingredients, especially for at-home hotpot and barbecue products. Its product portfolio includes eight categories: hotpot products, barbecue products, beverages, solo-dining meals, ready-to-cook meal kits, fresh produce, western cuisines, and snacks. The company operates primarily through a franchised retail store network and online sales channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a one-product-one-factory strategy with three self-operated production plants specializing in beef processing, meatball production, and hotpot soup base production. It invests in R&D to innovate and upgrade products, focusing on nutritious, healthy, and organic offerings. The supply chain is highly digitalized, enabling efficient management from procurement to retail, with next-day delivery capabilities and barcode inventory management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Guoquan serves franchisees who operate retail stores under its brand, as well as enterprise customers including food wholesalers, supermarkets, and restaurants. It also sells directly to end consumers through online platforms and third-party food delivery services. The primary market is consumers in China seeking convenient, affordable, and high-quality home meal products for various dining scenarios.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across mainland China, with a retail store network covering 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. All revenue and non-current assets are derived from and located in mainland China. It also has a principal place of business in Hong Kong and subsidiaries registered in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guoquan operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain. It controls production through its own factories and investments in suppliers, manages supply chain logistics and warehousing, and distributes products downstream to franchised retail stores and online channels. The company emphasizes streamlined supply chain management to optimize costs and ensure product quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in product development with a customer-driven and C2F (consumer-to-factory) approach, regularly launching new SKUs and upgrading existing products. It focuses on healthy, nutritious, and organic food products aligned with the 'Healthy China 2030' initiative. Guoquan plans to enhance R&D investment, collaborate with universities and research institutions, and integrate upstream resources through partnerships and investments to strengthen its core competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from product sales to franchisees who operate retail stores under the Guoquan Shihui brand, accounting for over 88% of sales. Additional revenue comes from sales to enterprise customers and direct sales to end consumers via online platforms and third-party delivery services. The company also earns service income related to franchise operations but does not rely on franchise fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The report does not explicitly name competitors but positions Guoquan as the leading one-stop home meal products brand in China with the largest retail store network in the sector. Its competitive advantages include a diversified product portfolio, strong supply chain capabilities, digitalized operations, and extensive franchisee support, enabling it to capture significant market growth potential.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2023, Guoquan reported revenue of RMB 6,094.1 million, a 15% decrease from 2022, mainly due to economic challenges and changes in consumer dining behavior post-pandemic. Despite revenue decline, gross profit increased by 8.2% to RMB 1,350.9 million with a gross margin improvement to 22.2%. Net profit rose by 9.3% to RMB 263.4 million, with adjusted net profit up 23.8%. The company operates over 10,300 stores and has a net asset value of RMB 3,378.8 million as of end 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guoquan emphasizes providing tasty, convenient, and affordable home meal products that cater to diverse dining scenarios and consumer preferences. Its value proposition includes a one-stop shopping experience with a broad and curated product portfolio, high-quality ingredients, and efficient supply chain management ensuring product safety and freshness. The company differentiates itself through digital empowerment of supply chain and franchisees, customer-centric innovation, and extensive offline and online consumer reach.
